title: Chombueng Marathon 2027 Review: A 40th Edition at a Muay Thai University
meta_description: Chombueng Marathon 2027 review: January 31, the 40th edition at Muban Chombueng Rajabhat University -- one of few universities with a Muay Thai faculty.
dek: Set for 31 January 2027, the landmark 40th edition of the Chombueng Marathon starts at Muban Chombueng Rajabhat University in Ratchaburi -- a school with roots to 1954 and one of the few universities anywhere with a dedicated Faculty of Muay Thai Studies.
verdict: The Chombueng Marathon's 40th edition carries genuinely exceptional continuity -- among the longest track records in this entire research batch, on par with the 37-year Bangkok Marathon. The venue, Muban Chombueng Rajabhat University, traces its roots to 1954 as a village college, gaining full university status in 2004, and stands out for having one of the few dedicated Faculty of Muay Thai Studies programs anywhere in the world. Two distances (21.1K/42.195K) at a genuinely distinctive institutional venue make this a strong pick, though registration status wasn't yet announced at the time of this research.

sections.heading: 40 Years of Continuous Racing
paragraphs: The 2027 race marks the landmark 40th edition of the Chombueng Marathon, offering two distances: the 21.1K half marathon and the 42.195K full marathon. [1] That's among the longest track records of any race covered in this entire research batch -- comparable to the 37-year Bangkok Marathon and well ahead of most newer events.

sections.heading: A University With a Rare Muay Thai Faculty
paragraphs: The race starts at Muban Chombueng Rajabhat University, located in Chom Bueng district, Ratchaburi province, about 130km west of Bangkok. [2] The institution traces back to 1954 as Chom Bueng Village College, becoming a teachers college in 1970, and gaining full university status in 2004. Genuinely unusual among its six faculties: a dedicated Faculty of Muay Thai Studies, alongside education, management science, science and technology, humanities and social sciences, and industrial technology.

sections.heading: A Genuinely Rare Institutional Focus
paragraphs: A university with a Faculty of Muay Thai Studies is a genuine rarity globally, giving this race's start venue a distinctly Thai cultural character beyond a typical academic campus -- worth knowing for runners interested in the country's national martial art alongside the marathon itself.

sections.heading: Registration Not Yet Announced
paragraphs: As of this writing, registration status has not been announced. [1] Given the race's 40-edition history, this is likely standard pre-season timing rather than any operational uncertainty.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If a marathon with genuine 40-year continuity, starting at a university with one of the world's few dedicated Muay Thai academic faculties, appeals, the Chombueng Marathon on 31 January 2027 is a distinctive, well-established pick. Watch official channels for registration to open.
